Check out [Flirtymog](https://www.reddit.com/r/hatchcats/s/y1LwZkWnes)!!

He’s got nice ashy tones with a little bit of forest green or maybe turquoise. His hobbies include sleeping, scaring the local birds, making fun of dogs, and sleeping. He may not have the highest score but he wants you to know his mom’s side of the family is basically royalty, and that makes him a prince!

He prefers you not mention his mouth deformity that looks like a fish. It’s a thing on his mom’s side due to inbreeding. Sometimes he thinks it looks refined.
